conclusion.for_fme: No public proteomics dataset tests the FME blunted-response signature at protein level. FM blood proteomics (2025) screens high-abundance proteins and misses cytokines. FM CSF (2018) has CA14 detectable but the study's differential analysis was not available in accessible format for quantitative re-analysis. The blunted-response hypothesis at protein level remains UNTESTED in public data.
conclusion.kill_criterion_result: FAIL (no protein-level correlate available to test) — grounding-B hypothesis: 'blunted-response RNA has protein-level correlate' remains UNTESTED, not falsified
